name: Dynamic Veneto 1-2 Person Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Veneto 1-2 Person Low EMF (Between 5-10 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Looking for an easy way to relax and recharge at home? Dynamic Saunas are made from eco-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood and feature Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that deliver safe, energy-efficient warmth. Each session helps ease stress, improve circulation, and restore balance to your body. Compact and versatile, these saunas can be installed in basements, master baths, walk-in closets, or even home gyms. With their sleek design and powerful health benefits, Dynamic Saunas turn any space into a personal retreat for daily comfort and wellness. Features: Low EMF - EMF between 5-10 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels 1-2 person capacity Natural Canadian Reforested Hemlock wood construction Easy Removable Bench - Stretching, Exercise, or Yoga Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with red light feature Heating Elements: 7 Dynamic Low EMF (EMF between 5-10MG - 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels 2 on the rear wall 2 on each side wall and 1 under the bench Roof vent Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth, MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Clasp together assembly Ships in 2 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 250 lbs. Shipping weight: 300 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15amp plug & play Exterior dimensions (LWH): 36" x 39" x 75" Interior dimensions (LWH): 32" x 35" x 68" Document: View Owner's Manual
